notes: Reference date 2018-02-22. Governing documents: ACD 710 (rev. 7/1/2016; accepted as in force, flagged version_uncertain), ACD 702-03, ACD 702-02, ACD 707, ACD 506-03 (all rev. 7/1/2011, captures 2016). The July 2017 provost page (2018_05) is an informational summary pointing to ACD 710 and SPP 708; where it differs ('up to 12 weeks' of alternate duties; per-family six-week limit) ACD 710 governs.

2018_00_link is a September 2018 capture of the provost page showing amendments of June 11, 2018 onward (12 weeks of paid leave, 18 combined for two ASU parents; alternative duties only to the end of the semester in progress, or the ensuing semester for those unable to use the leave; grad/postdoc 12 weeks with split between two student parents; Disability Resource Center accommodations for pregnant students). It is not policy on 2018-02-22: its 12-week leave is recorded as c11, flagged not_yet_effective; its other changes are noted here only.

Birth parent chain: ACD 710 paid parental leave 6 (FMLA family leave 12 workweeks concurrent from the start) -> temporary assignment of alternate duties 12+ weeks (to end of term) consecutive_after the paid leave; own sick/vacation balances may keep pay status beyond the paid leave (consecutive_after c1, uncounted); ACD 707 unpaid leave may follow the family leave (general purpose, uncounted).

Non-birth parent chain: identical to the birth parent's (ACD 710 is open to 'father' and 'domestic partners'): paid parental leave 6 (FMLA concurrent) -> alternate duties 12+ weeks consecutive_after it.

Short-term disability insurance: ACD 710 says paid parental leave coordinates with 'any group disability income replacement benefit policy (e.g., short-term disability insurance)' and refers to the HR Benefits Web site (not saved); no plan terms, funding or eligibility are in the saved documents, so no component was created.
Staff (SPP 708, not saved) are covered by the same provost summary; their provisions are not coded separately. Graduate assistants and postdocs (c12) are another group, recorded and not counted.

Documents cited but not saved: SPP 708; ACD 704-01 Vacation Leave; ACD 702-04 Bereavement Leave; ACD 705 Sabbatical Leave; ACD 507-05 Academic Professional Probationary Appointments; ACD 506-04 Tenure; ACD 506-05 Faculty Promotion; ACD 506-10; ACD 505-04; ACD 508-01; ACD 509-02; ACD 112-01; ACD 601-06 Workers' Compensation; P15 Family Leave Procedures; P2; P3; ABOR Policy Manual 6-201, 6-804, 6-805; HR Benefits Web site (short-term disability); Request for Leave of Absence form; the 'summary guide' linked from 2018_00. Only SPP 708, ACD 704-01, P15 and the HR Benefits site bear on parental provisions; flagged on c1, c3, c6.
Sabbatical leave (ACD 705) 'may not be used for parental leave': not a component. Bereavement leave: not a component (death). Stillbirth use of paid parental leave is part of c1.
